Skyforge. This MMORPG is a spiritual successor to the entire genre and has literally every amazing feature from every MMORPG that came before it. Massive sill trees (like Path of Exile), amazing graphics, incredibly detailed character customization, fast paced combat, you can unlock every class on a character and switch between them freely, it has a follower system (continues working while offline), and the story is on point. Class playing styles vary drastically from class to class. Amazing game. I will never return to WoW or TERA or Wildstar or SWTOR.
Hmm... I guess I can give it a shot... What's the gameplay like more specifically? Like what are the controls

It really depends on the class. For instance, the Monk consists of combos and stances. So in the fire stance you'll click your LMB once and do a basic attack, then clicking your LMB again will do a different attack as will RMB. If you click the RMB you end the combo if you click LMB you again are given two new LMB RMB choices. These combos are quick (in between the pace of a fighting game and an action MMORPG like TERA or Neverwinter) and you also have 3-6 other skills you will be using depending on your stance. You can change stances as quickly as you can use skills.

Cryomancer is like the Mage class for Skyforge. It is not a 'superb' DPS class but it has great crowd control. You can mash your LMB for a basic attack that generates resource or hold it down (.3s i think) for a charged area attack. A lot of Cryo skills have multiple charge levels that will change the type of attack (area vs. single point, dmg vs. dmg over time).

Another great class is Kinetic. Kinetic deals huge burst damage. Mashing LMB applies a stack which boosts damage of RMB. You generate a gravity bubble in which your enemies are slowed and take more damage and you float and are sped up.

When an enemies health gets low enough, all classes have a signature finishing move (used by pressing E).

Every class has an ultimate skill (R) (similar to in League of Legends or other MOBAs) with a long cool down.

You can only start by playing the three starting classes until you get further in your skill tree and unlock the other classes but you can try out every class in the Research Lab, and in the Training Missions.
